invariants: at most one edge per source
all edges go to a later lexicographic layer

derivation.premise: Every counter magnitude is bounded by the unary input length N.
derivation.conclusion: Signed counters require at most ceil(log2(2N+1))=O(log N) bits.

derivation.premise: If every log-precision nonlinear RNN had o(log^2 n)-depth circuits, the fixed RNN for an FO-complete L language would, under FO composition, give that depth to every L language.
derivation.conclusion: Under the stated assumption, some log-precision nonlinear RNN requires Omega(log^2 n) depth.

conditional_conclusion.antecedent: Not every language in L has a polynomial-size bounded-fan-in Boolean circuit family of depth o(log^2 n).
conditional_conclusion.consequent: There exists a log-precision nonlinear RNN requiring Omega(log^2 n) circuit depth to simulate.
